summary: mangomind-agent connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay that can execute arbitrary shell commands on the installer's host
details: src/index.js opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded relay at wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app. On messages of type 'diagnosis' with autoFix:true, the code passes msg.fixCommand directly to execSync on the host, giving the remote endpoint arbitrary shell execution under the user's privileges. The same file collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), process.platform) and issues outbound HTTP/curl calls, and at CLI startup runs an unpinned 'npm install -g opencode-ai' and 'curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash' fallback. The remote-controlled execSync sink is a backdoor regardless of the CLI-invocation trigger, because whoever controls the relay controls the command string executed on every running agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
